blocks.en: # Glossary and command reference **English** · [简体中文](GLOSSARY.zh-CN.md) [Repository home](../README.md#contents) ## Core terms | Term | Definition | | --- | --- | | PDBQT | AutoDock coordinates with partial charges, atom types, and ligand torsion trees | | SDF | Structure records containing coordinates and a chemical graph | | MOL2 | Tripos representation for coordinates, connectivity, types and charges | | Docking pose | Predicted ligand orientation and conformation in the receptor frame | | Receptor | Target macromolecule in a specified modeling state | | Force field | Potential energy model and parameter set | | Topology | Atom order, interactions, parameters and molecule counts | | PME | Particle mesh Ewald, a periodic long-range electrostatics method | | LJ-PME | Lattice-sum treatment of long-range Lennard–Jones dispersion | | RESI | Residue or ligand identifier in CHARMM parameter files | | GRO / TPR / CPT | GROMACS coordinates (nm), run input, and checkpoint | | XTC | Lossily compressed coordinate trajectory | | PLIP / ProLIF | Interaction annotator for structures / interaction fingerprints for trajectories and poses | ## Frequently used command flags | Flag | Reason | | --- | --- | | Vina `--receptor`, `--ligand`, `--config` | Set docking receptor, ligand and search box inputs | | Vina `--seed`, `--exhaustiveness`, `--num_modes`, `--out` | Record RNG seed, vary search effort, limit written poses, and specify the output file | | GROMACS `-f`, `-c`, `-s`, `-p` | Check the subcommand: for grompp these are parameter file, coordinates and topology via `-f`, `-c`, `-p`; many analysis commands use `-f` for the trajectory and `-s` for TPR/reference | | grompp `-r`, `-t`, `-n`, `-pp`, `-po`, `-o` | Supply restrained reference, checkpoint, and index; save expanded topology, processed parameters and TPR | | mdrun `-deffnm`, `-ntmpi`, `-ntomp`, `-cpi` | Set file prefix, ranks, threads per rank, and restart checkpoint | | hbond `-r`, `-t`, `-num` in GROMACS 2026.3 | Select reference and target explicitly and write counts versus time | | ACPYPE `-i`, `-b`, `-a`, `-c`, `-n` | MOL2 input, output basename, GAFF family, charge model, and verified total ligand charge | [GROMACS 2026.3 Manual](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/) · [AutoDock Vina Documentation](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
blocks.zh: # 术语表与命令参数 [English](GLOSSARY.md) · **简体中文** [仓库首页](../README.zh-CN.md#contents) ## 核心术语 | 术语 | 定义 | | --- | --- | | PDBQT（AutoDock 坐标格式） | 记录坐标、partial charge（部分电荷）、原子类型及配体扭转树 | | SDF（结构数据文件） | 保存坐标与化学图的分子记录 | | MOL2（Tripos 分子格式） | 保存坐标、连通关系、类型和电荷 | | docking pose（对接位姿） | 在 receptor（受体）坐标系下预测的配体取向和构象 | | receptor（受体） | 采用确定建模状态的目标生物大分子 | | force field（力场） | 势能模型及其参数集 | | topology（拓扑） | 原子顺序、相互作用、参数和分子数量 | | PME（粒子网格 Ewald） | 周期体系下电子静电相互作用的长程求和方法 | | LJ-PME（Lennard–Jones 粒子网格 Ewald） | 长程色散的格点求和 | | RESI（残基名称） | CHARMM 参数文件中的残基或配体标识 | | GRO / TPR / CPT | GROMACS 坐标（nm）、运行输入和检查点 | | XTC（压缩轨迹） | 有损压缩的坐标轨迹 | | PLIP / ProLIF | 结构相互作用注释工具 / 轨迹和 docking pose（对接位姿）的相互作用指纹工具 | ## 常用命令参数 | 参数 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | Vina `--receptor`、`--ligand`、`--config` | 设置对接 receptor（受体）、配体和搜索盒输入 | | Vina `--seed`、`--exhaustiveness`、`--num_modes`、`--out` | 记录随机种子、调节搜索力度、限制输出模式数及指定文件 | | GROMACS `-f`、`-c`、`-s`、`-p` | 按子命令查询：grompp 的 `-f`、`-c`、`-p` 分别是参数、坐标和 topology（拓扑）；多数分析的 `-f`、`-s` 分别是轨迹和 TPR/参考结构 | | grompp `-r`、`-t`、`-n`、`-pp`、`-po`、`-o` | 输入限制参考、检查点及索引，记录展开的 topology（拓扑）、预处理参数和 TPR | | mdrun `-deffnm`、`-ntmpi`、`-ntomp`、`-cpi` | 设定文件前缀、进程数、每进程线程数和续跑检查点 | | GROMACS 2026.3 `hbond` 的 `-r`、`-t`、`-num` | 显式选择参考组与目标组，输出氢键数量随时间变化 | | ACPYPE `-i`、`-b`、`-a`、`-c`、`-n` | MOL2 输入、输出前缀、GAFF 系列、电荷模型和已核验的配体总电荷 | [GROMACS 2026.3 Manual](https://manual.gromacs.org/2026.3/) · [AutoDock Vina Documentation](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
